criteria.reason: Clear step-by-step Fermi estimate: cup size, per-capita cups, population, multiplication, and error sources all shown explicitly.
Population labeled data; cups-per-drinker and drinker share labeled assumptions with margins of error at each stage.
Gives 20-40 million range plus ±10-20 million uncertainty; final estimate narrows toward 35-40 million, slightly overconfident.
Cites ICO, Eurostat, Swiss Coffee Association vaguely; population unsourced; per-capita figure not anchored to ICO's ~1,069 cups/year.

factual_errors: Population given as ~8.9 million; permanent resident population was 9,127,100 at end-2025.
'Rista' is not a recognized coffee term (presumably meant ristretto).
Upper bound of 5 cups/day per adult is roughly double ICO's ~1,069 cups/year (~3/day figure.
summary: Strong, transparent Fermi estimate with clear steps, labeled assumptions, and wide uncertainty ranges; population figure slightly outdated and sourcing vague, but no refusal or precision overclaim.
